Subject: Request: retro invoices + payee change for EU entity

Hi Soojin,

We need your help making a couple of updates for our accounting records before we close November books. Two items: 1) a backfill for invoices issued July and August 2025 so they show Hippo Zap Europe Ltd as the payee, and 2) enrollment in your billing portal so our AP team can download invoices going forward.

Attached is a CSV list of the invoices we believe need the payee swap (invoice_list_Jul-Aug.csv). Can you confirm whether you can reissue or provide credit memos + reissued invoices? Also confirm what evidence you need for the EU entity change (VAT registration, signed amendment, etc.). Our preferred delivery method going forward is the portal, but we can accept encrypted PDFs to ap@hippozap.com while portal enrollment is in process.

PO numbers for the invoices are included in the CSV. Please let me know a timeline for the backfill and any next steps we need to sign.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of AP Operations
Hippo Zap

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear summary and the CSV. We're able to support two paths for this: (A) reissue invoices from our EU billing entity (Hippo Zap Europe Ltd as payee) or (B) issue a credit memo and reissue from the new payee. For accounting cleanliness we usually do the credit + reissue flow.

To proceed we'll need:
- Signed amendment authorizing the payee change (legal).
- VAT registration for Hippo Zap Europe Ltd (EU VAT ID).
- Confirmation of the final payee name and remit address to appear on the reissued invoices.
- Preferred tech delivery: portal enrollment request (recommended) or SFTP / encrypted PDF to ap@hippozap.com.

I've attached our quick backfill checklist which outlines the documents we need and the expected timeline once we receive everything (backfill_checklist.xlsx). Quick notes: once docs are in and PO numbers match, typical turnaround is 7-10 business days for credit + reissue; if you want SFTP delivery we can compress to ~5 business days. Portal enrollment often takes 2-3 business days if your IT approves our connector.

If you want, Connor (cc'd) can open the backfill job and send a DocuSign amendment link for signature. Let me know which delivery method you prefer.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Lead, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Hi Elena — looping in Billing Ops to confirm the runbook and next steps. Per Soojin's note:

Planned workflow (summary):
1) We generate DocuSign amendment and send to your legal/ops for signature (link below).
2) Once signed + VAT evidence received, we create credit memos for the July/Aug invoices and reissue invoices from Hippo Zap Europe Ltd.
3) Reissued invoices will be delivered to the portal by default; if portal onboarding is delayed we'll push encrypted PDFs to ap@hippozap.com or SFTP.
4) Backfill job ETA: 7 business days after receipt of signed amendment + VAT cert. If you elect SFTP delivery and provide host/user creds we can target 5 business days.

Two action items for you:
- Sign the amendment here: https://app.docusign.com/hippozap/amendment/ABC123
- Upload VAT evidence to the portal or email encrypted copy to ap@hippozap.com

I've attached a sample mapping CSV for your ERP team (hippozap_mapping_sample.csv). Also noting that the backfill will appear as credit memos + new invoices in the November statement; the credits will net out for the revised payee. If you need a standalone report for reconciliation we can produce one.

If all good we'll kick off once the amendment is signed.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
